//: The BROWSER half of the typecheck (WP-22, 01-AUDIT.md F21). Everything in
public/ is served as a static file and runs in a tab: DOM libs, no Node
globals, no `types/node.d.ts`. A `process` or a `Buffer` reached for from
here is a type error, which is the static-file boundary stated in the one
place a tool can enforce it.
It lives in public/ rather than at the root so an editor picks the right
project for the file it has open. `npm run typecheck` runs both.
